map.输入基础URL与来源、媒介、活动等参数，单条或按行批量生成带 UTM 的追踪链接: Enter a base URL plus source, medium and campaign, and generate UTM tracking links one at a time or in bulk by line; URL, source, medium and campaign are required, while term/content are optional.
map.工具把 utm_source、utm_medium、utm_campaign 与: The tool appends utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign plus optional utm_term and utm_content to the base URL: existing utm_* keys are replaced, parameters go before the # anchor, and Chinese characters and spaces are encoded by URLSearchParams. With batch URLs, one link per line receives the same parameter set, and each line can be copied or exported as CSV.
map.填写来源 utm_source、媒介 utm_medium、活动名称 utm_c: Enter source utm_source, medium utm_medium and campaign utm_campaign.
map.按需填写关键词 utm_term 与内容 utm_content（可留空）。: Optionally enter keyword utm_term and content utm_content.
map.需要批量时，在“批量网址”框每行填一个链接；留空则只生成单条。: For batch mode, enter one link per line in the batch box; leave it empty to generate a single link.
map.复制单条链接，或在批量列表逐行复制/导出 CSV。: Copy the single link, or copy each line or export CSV in the batch list.
map.为不同渠道/活动生成带 UTM 的追踪链接。: Generate tracked links with UTM tags for different channels and campaigns.
map.规范 utm_source/medium/campaign 命名便于归因。: Standardize utm_source/medium/campaign naming to make attribution easy.
map.批量生成多活动链接导入投放后台。: Generate links for multiple campaigns in bulk and import them into the delivery platform.
map.：来源 wechat、媒介 cpc、活动 spring_sale → 原链接后接: : source wechat, medium cpc, campaign spring_sale -> append ?utm_source=wechat&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=spring_sale to the original link, so GA can split by channel.
map.：批量框填两条落地页，同一组 wechat / social / summer_: : enter two landing pages in the batch box, and the same wechat / social / summer_promo parameters generate two links that can be copied individually or exported as CSV.
map.社交媒体图片尺寸速查: Social media image size quick reference
map.UTM 中文会有问题吗？: Are there problems with Chinese in UTM parameters?
map.会。中文与空格需 URL 编码，本工具用 URLSearchParams 自动编: Yes. Chinese characters and spaces need URL encoding, which this tool performs automatically with URLSearchParams; some backends still parse them abnormally, so all-lowercase English with underscores is safer.
map.URL、来源 utm_source、媒介 utm_medium、活动 utm_c: URL, utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign are required; term and content are optional and are omitted when empty. Batch mode requires the same four items, with URLs entered one per line.
